name: Zhejiang Fore Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 浙江丰立智能科技股份有限公司
summary: FORE manufactures precision transmission components, harmonic reducers and gears. Its robotics portfolio includes cup-type and hat-type harmonic reducer families and bevel gear pairs identified for robot joints. Its wider business also serves vehicle, household drive and pneumatic tool applications.
